'''''Chamaemeles''''' is a [[monotypic]] genus of flowering plants in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Rosaceae]]. Its only species, '''''Chamaemeles coriacea''''', is [[endemic]] to [[Madeira]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Chamaemeles coriacea Lindl. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/5XPWG |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=20 April 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Chamaemeles coriacea Lindl. |url=https://madeira.flora-on.pt/#/1chamaemeles |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=20 April 2021}}</ref>
